SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status = #{status}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order (order_no, buyer_id, seller_id, product_id, product_title, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, status, payment_deadline, idempotent_key, version) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{productId}, #{productTitle}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{paymentDeadline}, #{idempotentKey}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order SET status = #{newStatus}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE t_order SET status = #{newStatus}, paid_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE t_order SET status = #{newStatus}, shipped_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE t_order SET status = #{newStatus}, received_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE t_order SET status = #{newStatus}, closed_at = NOW(), close_reason = #{closeReason}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND version = #{version}
